title: The local Cauchy problem for hyperbolic systems of equations with fractional dissipation
summary: We study the local well-posedness of the Cauchy problem for a class of hyperbolic quasilinear evolution systems with fractional dissipation and commutators of the fractional Laplacian $(-Δ)^α$ with $α\in(0,1)$. The analysis is motivated by the compressible isentropic Navier-Stokes equations with fractional diffusion and the compressible Euler alignment system with singular communication weights.
